kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننسرح (form VII)
# نَنْسَرِحُ (nansariḥu) /nan.sa.ri.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْسَرَحَ (insaraḥa)
# نَنْسَرِحَ (nansariḥa) /nan.sa.ri.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَرَحَ (insaraḥa)
# نَنْسَرِحْ (nansariḥ) /nan.sa.riħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْسَرَحَ (insaraḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
